name: KrakenFiles
description: Resolves KrakenFiles links without an account through the file page's download form and its Cloudflare Turnstile.

codes.krakenfiles.direct_link_foreign: KrakenFiles handed out a download link on {host}, which this plugin may not download from
codes.krakenfiles.direct_link_missing: KrakenFiles accepted the download request but returned no download link
codes.krakenfiles.file_unavailable: KrakenFiles file has been deleted or never existed
codes.krakenfiles.no_account: This resolver downloads without an account and has none to check
codes.krakenfiles.page_layout_changed: The KrakenFiles file page no longer looks as expected: {diagnosis}
codes.krakenfiles.rate_limited: KrakenFiles refused the download link (HTTP {status}); too many connections, try again in an hour
